encoder: resnet18 ImageNet V1 first stage frozen under no_grad; native BN training behavior retained
volume_normalization: CVN dims(0,1), native auto fallback for category names not in SVN list; exact BTAD-specific config unavailable
optimizer: Adam lr2e-4 eps1e-4 weight_decay1e-5 betas(0.5,0.9), fused
loss: native BatchDiffLoss p2 -> native compose -> channel mean -> FFT2 abs mean
input: Resize fixed square1024 bilinear / ImageNet normalization
mask: Resize fixed square256 bilinear then native ToTensor round int
precision: FP32, TF32 enabled only after recorded loss/gradient check; no AMP for FFT
checkpoint_selection: last epoch15; native demo saves best test pixel/pro checkpoints, report final instead
evaluation: all normal train batch1 latent mean template; test batch4 abs latent differences compose -> channel mean, no smoothing; image max
resume_policy: Reuse finished epoch15 checkpoints with 15-row training history and saved GPU proof. No partial-epoch resume.
